notes: I recognized the topic (inoculation prompting, with a concurrent anonymous paper cited in Sec 4) from prior knowledge but do not know the decision; reviewed on merits. integrity_scan.py (Phase 0) was run although the task's tool list named only the aggregation and related_search scripts; it wrote reviewer_copy.txt inside the results directory and found nothing. Ambiguities: (1) The paper reports almost all results in figures with no tables, so the skill's 'recompute two headline deltas' rules could only be applied to the text-stated correlations and to the App. M algebra. (2) The skill's Phase 1.6 report check assumes drafts that can be revised; with sequential single-context passes the dropped items are the author's own redundancies, which makes the table somewhat artificial. (3) Pool-position bands (e.g., 55-69 maps to scores 55-61) conflict with the instruction that Overall 4 needs pool >= 65, so I had to move one reviewer's pool position to 70 to match its dimension scores. (4) The related_search.py query limit (4 concept words) refused one claim query and the skill gives no instruction on retrying beyond the 12-query budget; I did not re-run it, so claim C3 has no dedicated query. (5) The ICLR label printed by aggregate.json ('6 on {0,2,4,6,8,10}') is not comparable to the internal 1-6 label without reading venue_profiles.md; the 'official_rating' (plain mean on the internal scale) is not an ICLR rating. (6) The EIC weighting formula (confidence x weight) and the starting-point rounding are clear, but the skill does not say whether the pool position and the 0-100 composite cross-check should be reported in the final JSON for the EIC beyond what aggregate_scores.py outputs. (7) Several quoted phrases span extracted-text line breaks, so evidence quotes were chosen from single lines.
